messages:
OncallBot: SEV2 pager triggered for embedder-service in us-east-1 — high tail latency impacting ~12% of requests. 5xxs + latency spike. Dashboard: https://redwood.app/alerts/2760012345 :rotating_light:

Maya: On it, live mitigation started — spinning extra replicas and enabling small-model fallback for low-priority requests. Seeing ~20% latency reduction so far. Suspect KV cache thrash during load burst.

AJ: thanks — can you paste the error snippet or top logs?

Maya: sure, quick excerpt:
```
2026-03-17T14:05:12Z embedder kv: evict miss spike=0.78 keys/sec
2026-03-17T14:05:13Z model-serve: request latency p99=1200ms p50=230ms
2026-03-17T14:05:14Z ops: replica spin-up initiated (n=2 -> 4)
```

Sofia: if it's KV eviction we should try increasing LRU window and bumping cache memc for the hot shard. @Maya can you try a conservative LRU increase and report? Also flagging deployments team in case autoscaler mis-tuned.

Maya: doing LRU window +1 (conservative) now. will monitor 5m then hand off.

Liam: I'll take post-page coordination and postmortem scheduling after Maya's watch window. @Maya ping me when you're ready to hand off.

OncallBot: Page status update — error rate trending down to baseline at 14:14 UTC. Auto-check: requests back within SLOs at 14:18 UTC.

Maya: handing off to @Liam at 14:20 UTC. Mitigation held stability for 15m. Root cause suspected: short-lived KV thrash + autoscaler lag for cold-starts. No data exfiltration.

Liam: TL;DR customer impact: ~12% of requests saw tail latency bump ~200–500ms for a ~12m window. Three paying customers crossed their error thresholds (acct-117, acct-402, acct-811) — CS notified. I recommend a standard postmortem (SEV2) and a small set of action items.

Emily: thanks — CS received initial heads-up. Do we need a customer-facing follow-up or is an internal note enough?

Liam: suggest customer-facing summary for the three accounts + internal postmortem doc. Notifying customers scheduled after postmortem draft.

Maya: suggested action items (first pass):
- AI-2761: KV LRU tuning for hot shards + add shard-level eviction metrics (owner: Maya) — estimate: 8h
- AI-2762: Autoscaler cooldown exam and adjust cold-start policy for model replicas (owner: AJ) — estimate: 16h
- AI-2763: Add circuit-breaker and structured fallback policy to SDK + docs (owner: Liam) — estimate: 3d
- AI-2764: Postmortem doc + customer summary + notify CS (owner: Emily) — estimate: 4h
- AI-2765: Add a chaos test simulating KV thrash to our infra-tests (owner: AJ) — estimate: 5d

Sofia: quick sizing notes: AI-2761 is small (S), AI-2762 medium (M), AI-2763 medium (M) but impactful, AI-2765 large (L) — should land in next infra sprint triage.

AJ: I'll pick up AI-2762 and AI-2765. For the chaos test I want 5d to cover test infra + failure modes.

Liam: Priority ordering proposal: 1) AI-2761 (quick fix, metrics) 2) AI-2763 (fallback/cb) 3) AI-2762 (autoscaler) 4) AI-2764 (postmortem comms) 5) AI-2765 (chaos). Move AI-2763 into Q2 infra sprint planning — high ROI for customer impact reduction. :calendar:

Emily: agree with priority. I'll draft the customer-facing summary once @Liam posts the postmortem doc.

Maya: monitoring hooks added for eviction metrics (in staging, rolling to prod in 10m).

OncallBot: Incident resolved. Postmortem requested by @Liam — meeting scheduled: 2026-03-19 15:00 UTC (link: https://meet.redwood/postmortem/2760012345). Postmortem doc: https://docs.redwood/postmortems/2760012345.

Liam: I've created the postmortem doc and added initial timeline + action items. Please comment on AI sizing in the doc. I'll convert AI-2761..2765 into tickets and tag owners.

AJ: copied — will add acceptance criteria for AI-2762/2765.

Sofia: please make sure AI-2761 includes the metric dashboards + alert thresholds so we don't miss similar patterns.

Emily: I'll queue customer comms after the postmortem is finalized. ETA for notice: within 48h post-doc.

Maya: handing monitoring to infra rotation — I'll follow up if we see regressions. :thumbsup:

Liam: thanks all. Closing thread for live mitigation. Action items will be tracked in the roadmap board — @product and @infra leads FYI for Q2 planning.

Emily: ack.

OncallBot: Thread archived at 14:30 UTC.
